latest_release.name: Release v0.9.5
latest_release.body:
## 🎉 Crawl4AI v0.9.5 Released!

### 📦 Installation

**PyPI:**
```bash
pip install crawl4ai==0.9.5
```

**Docker:**
```bash
docker pull unclecode/crawl4ai:0.9.5
docker pull unclecode/crawl4ai:latest
```

**Note:** Docker images are being built and will be available shortly.
Check the [Docker Release workflow](https://github.com/unclecode/crawl4ai/actions/workflows/docker-release.yml) for build status.

### 📝 What's Changed
See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/unclecode/crawl4ai/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for details.

hot_issues.title: [Bug]: When extracting data with scroll_full_page, only the final elements get parsed
[Bug]: Memory Leak on Repeated /md Requests via Docker (MacOS) — Container Crashes Randomly Over Time
[docs] DOM XSS: unescaped innerHTML interpolation in docs/apps/linkdin graph view template (5 sinks)
unclecode-litellm shadows the upstream litellm package; the quarantine that motivated the fork has been lifted
[Bug]: After a streamed deep crawl is stopped early, the next deep crawl returns only the start page
[Bug]: Browser pages and renderer processes accumulate for weeks on non-streaming /crawl (Docker 0.9.2)
Feature request: opt-out for the mandatory token when binding non-loopback (Kubernetes / trusted-network deployments)
[Bug]: Markdown export loses heading hierarchy and table structure

discussions.title: RAG Source Receipts: offline content and processing fingerprints for Crawl4AI outputs (early MVP)
[Feature Request]: Staged build to decrease image size
Proposal: versioned content blocks and meaningful change events
Show and tell: Hardening Downstream Database Tools Against Indirect Prompt Injections in Crawl4AI Pipelines
Crawl4AI is #2 in Data and scraping for AI on Archestack (badge, if you want it)
Crawl4AI CLI included in AgentManager's tool catalog
[Feature Request]: Lightweight HTTP-only crawling mode via DOM AST pruning (no browser required)

Crawl4AI

**Crawl4AI Cloud is a hosted web scraping, extraction, and search API for AI agents and data pipelines.** Turn pages into clean Markdown for RAG, extract structured JSON, or search the live web with one API key. Crawl4AI runs the browsers and manages the proxies. **[Get a free API key](https://crawl4ai.com/?ref=readme)** · 1,000 free credits every month. No credit card required. [Try a URL in the playground](https://crawl4ai.com/?ref=readme-playground#playground) · [Set up Crawl4AI Cloud in Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex](https://crawl4ai.com/llms.txt?ref=readme-llms) This repository is home to the Apache-2.0 crawler that powers Crawl4AI Cloud. [Run it yourself](#run-crawl4ai-yourself) with Python or Docker.
[![GitHub Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/unclecode/crawl4ai?style=social)](https://github.com/unclecode/crawl4ai/stargazers) [![PyPI version](https://badge.fury.io/py/crawl4ai.svg)](https://badge.fury.io/py/crawl4ai) [![Downloads](https://static.pepy.tech/badge/crawl4ai/month)](https://pepy.tech/project/crawl4ai) [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-join%20us-5865F2?logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/jP8KfhDhyN)
## Cloud quickstart Hosted API base URL: `https://api.crawl4ai.com`. [Cloud API reference](https://api.crawl4ai.com/docs) · [Agent setup and MCP](https://crawl4ai.com/llms.txt?ref=readme-llms) Set `CRAWL4AI_KEY` to your API key, then scrape a page as Markdown: ```bash curl -s https://api.crawl4ai.com/scrape \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $CRAWL4AI_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"url": "https://news.ycombinator.com"}' | jq -r .markdown ```
